applies_to: Laumas WLIGHT, installation and user manual version 1.03.
summary: The WLIGHT is a compact load-cell weight indicator with RS-485. In Modbus RTU mode it offers a small register set: identification, a command register, a status word, gross/net/peak weight as 32-bit pairs, the division and unit setting, and the sample weight used for calibration.

addressing.note: Registers are printed 40001-40066; subtract 40001 for a 0-based client (the manual's own example: 40028 -> 27). The read example uses start address 0x0007 for gross weight at 40008.

source.title: WLIGHT Installation and User Manual
source.pages: pp. 38-46 (Modbus RTU, register list, status register, divisions/units, commands, examples)

notes: Host: this copy is hosted by Massload, not by Laumas; no public copy was found on laumas.com.
Word order: H/L pairs with high word first; the read example returns gross 4000 as 0x0000 0x0FA0 and the -56 calibration example is 0xFFFF 0xFFC8, so ABCD is documented.

Weights are unsigned magnitudes without decimal point; the sign is in status bits 7-9. Divisions/units register 40014: low byte = division index (0-18: 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 2, 1 with 0 decimals; 0.5, 0.2, 0.1 with 1; 0.05, 0.02, 0.01 with 2; 0.005, 0.002, 0.001 with 3; 0.0005, 0.0002, 0.0001 with 4); high byte = unit index (0 kg, 1 g, 2 t, 3 lb, 4 N, 5 l, 6 bar, 7 atm, 8 pieces, 9 N m, 10 kg m, 11 other).
Command codes 1, 6, 20 and 98 are printed with names in display symbols that do not extract and are left out; 10-18 are reserved.
The manual's write example targets 40037-40038, which are not in this model's register list; treat it as a generic framing example.

integration.summary: Choose Modbus RTU in the serial menu, then read 40007-40013 with FC3 for status, gross, net and peak weight. Apply the sign bits and the division index. Write 7, 9 or 8 to 40006 for tare on, tare off and zero.
integration.enable: Serial communication is disabled by default: select the Modbus RTU protocol in the serial menu, then address (1-99, default 1), baud (default 9600), parity (default none), stop bits (default 1).
quirks: Only FC3 and FC16 are supported.
setup: Broadcast writes (address 0) are executed without reply; broadcast reads are ignored.
gotchas: Command 99 writes EEPROM, which allows about 100000 writes.
